methodology.control: same probe kernel and FIFO order, only allow_reopen changes
methodology.false_variant: deliberately incorrect ablation; never use as submitted solver
methodology.path_validation: every returned coordinate path legal and len(path)-1 equals returned cost
methodology.oracle: independent BFS; original core crosschecked for every case and heuristic
methodology.admissibility: zero or pointwise-lowered Manhattan; checked on all finite true distances
methodology.consistency: all directed open-grid edges checked, including nodes disconnected from goal
methodology.f_decrease_events: successive effective pop f decreases; includes goal pop; not a heuristic overestimate
methodology.reopened_nodes: actual repeated expansion; target not expanded
methodology.no_performance_ranking: no speed-up claim; ablation studies correctness and expansion events
